input.free_text_description: This system is an user management platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for user, user. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to interact with api base functionality, so that I can accomplish my api base-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with base functionality, so that I can accomplish my base-related tasks.
As a User, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Admin, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
